primary_claim: Models completely fail to compose two synthetic facts learned through fine-tuning without explicit chain-of-thought reasoning, achieving only chance-level accuracy despite perfect recall of the individual facts.
contradicts_or_qualifies: prior work inferring robust latent multi-hop reasoning capability from models' success on real-world two-hop question answering
stated_future_work: Researchers hoping to gain confidence in LLM agent oversight based on CoT monitoring should move beyond multihop question answering as a toy model of reasoning.
Determine monitorability via end-to-end evaluations where LLM agents attempt agentic tasks while their CoT is monitored by another model.
limitations_stated: Apparent limitations or successes on two-hop reasoning tasks may be artifacts of experimental setups (e.g. synthetic vs. pretraining-co-occurring facts) far removed from how frontier models are actually trained.
quote: Models completely fail to compose synthetic facts they learned through fine-tuning without explicit chain-of-thought reasoning, achieving only chance-level accuracy despite perfect recall of the individual facts.
